Sandbox_EHR_ZombieLootEnabled_tooltip: Gives each zombie a configurable chance to carry one random item from EHR's natural loot catalog. Knox cure items, craft-only or homemade items, and unfinished items are excluded. Existing vanilla and modded zombie loot is preserved.
Sandbox_EHR_ZombieLootChance_tooltip: Percentage chance for each zombie to receive one EHR item. <LINE> <LINE> 5.0 = about one in 20 zombies. A successful roll adds at most one item.
Sandbox_EHR_BloodLossMultiplier_tooltip: How fast blood drains from wounds. 1.0 = normal, 2.0 = twice as fast.
Sandbox_EHR_BloodThresholdHealthy_toolti: Blood percentage above which character is considered healthy.
Sandbox_EHR_BloodThresholdMild_tooltip: Blood percentage for mild blood loss effects.
Sandbox_EHR_BloodThresholdModerate_toolt: Blood percentage for moderate blood loss. Below this is CRITICAL.
Sandbox_EHR_BloodRegenEnabled_tooltip: Allow natural blood regeneration over time. <LINE> <LINE> HOW IT WORKS: <LINE> - Your body regenerates blood naturally when bleeding has stopped <LINE> - Regeneration only begins after a delay period (no active bleeding) <LINE> - Regeneration ONLY works if blood is above the minimum threshold <LINE> - Being fed, hydrated, and rested speeds up regeneration <LINE> <LINE> IMPORTANT: Transfusions are still the fastest way to restore blood in emergencies!
Sandbox_EHR_BloodRegenDelayHours_tooltip: Hours without bleeding before regeneration begins. <LINE> <LINE> HOW IT WORKS: <LINE> - Timer resets every time you start bleeding again <LINE> - Simulates your body stabilizing before producing new blood <LINE> - Lower values = faster recovery start <LINE> - Higher values = more realistic (body needs time to recover) <LINE> <LINE> RECOMMENDED: 2.0 hours (default) for balanced gameplay.
Sandbox_EHR_BloodRegenRatePerHour_toolti: Milliliters of blood regenerated per in-game hour. <LINE> <LINE> REFERENCE (5000 mL max blood): <LINE> - 50 mL/hr (default) = ~70 hours to fully recover from critical <LINE> - 100 mL/hr = ~35 hours to fully recover <LINE> - 200 mL/hr = ~17 hours (arcade mode) <LINE> <LINE> Real human regeneration is ~40-50 mL/hour. <LINE> Being well-fed and hydrated provides a 50%% bonus!
Sandbox_EHR_BloodRegenMinimumPercent_too: Minimum blood percentage required for regeneration to work. <LINE> <LINE> HOW IT WORKS: <LINE> - Below this threshold, your body is too weak to regenerate <LINE> - You MUST use blood transfusions to get above this level <LINE> - Simulates critical blood loss requiring medical intervention <LINE> <LINE> EXAMPLE (30%% default, 5000 mL max): <LINE> - Below 1500 mL = NO natural regeneration <LINE> - Need transfusion to reach 1500+ mL first <LINE> <LINE> Lower = more forgiving, Higher = more realistic/hardcore.
Sandbox_EHR_BlackoutEnabled_tooltip: Allow character to black out from critical blood loss.
Sandbox_EHR_BlackoutChance_tooltip: Random chance per tick. Lower = more frequent. 50 = 1 in 50 chance.
Sandbox_EHR_HealingRequiresFed_tooltip: Body parts only heal when not hungry.
Sandbox_EHR_HealingRequiresHydrated_tool: Body parts only heal when not thirsty.
Sandbox_EHR_HealingRequiresRested_toolti: Body parts only heal when not exhausted.
Sandbox_EHR_HealingRequiresCalm_tooltip: Body parts only heal when not stressed.
Sandbox_EHR_HealingRequiresNoPain_toolti: Body parts only heal when not in significant pain.
Sandbox_EHR_WoundInfectionSpeed_tooltip: How fast infections progress. 1.0 = normal, 2.0 = twice as fast.
Sandbox_EHR_CellulitisEnabled_tooltip: Skin infection from poor wound closure or untreated wound spread. Can progress to sepsis if not treated.
Sandbox_EHR_SepsisSpeed_tooltip: How fast sepsis progresses. 1.0 = normal, 2.0 = twice as fast.
Sandbox_EHR_TetanusEnabled_tooltip: LETHAL lockjaw from rusty/dirty deep wounds. Long incubation (3-7 days), then spasms, can't eat, death. Rare antitoxin required to survive.
Sandbox_EHR_DiseaseEnabled_tooltip: Enable food poisoning and other diseases.
Sandbox_EHR_DiseaseSpeed_tooltip: How fast diseases progress. 1.0 = normal, 2.0 = twice as fast.
Sandbox_EHR_FoodPoisoningEnabled_tooltip: Rotten, raw, or burned food causes food poisoning. Nausea, vomiting, dehydration. Survivable with proper hydration.
Sandbox_EHR_GastroenteritisEnabled_toolt: Stomach bug from eating with dirty/bloody hands. Causes vomiting and dehydration. Wash your hands!
Sandbox_EHR_TrichinosisEnabled_tooltip: Parasitic worm infection from raw/undercooked wild game (rats, boar, bear). SEVERE muscle pain, can be lethal. Cook your meat!
Sandbox_EHR_ToxinPoisoningEnabled_toolti: Dangerous poisoning from toxic mushrooms and berries. Can be lethal without fast treatment.
Sandbox_EHR_HyperkeratoticScabiesEnabled: Severe parasitic skin infestation from prolonged contact with dirt or grass. Causes itching, fever, wounds, and can become lethal.
Sandbox_EHR_DysenteryEnabled_tooltip: Drinking contaminated water can cause dysentery. LETHAL through dehydration.
Sandbox_EHR_CommonColdEnabled_tooltip: Cold weather + wet exposure can cause common cold. Can progress to pneumonia.
Sandbox_EHR_PneumoniaEnabled_tooltip: Untreated cold can become pneumonia. LETHAL without antibiotics. Coughing attracts zombies!
Sandbox_EHR_HypothermiaEnabled_tooltip: Low core body temperature causes hypothermia while the Body Temperature System is enabled. LETHAL - cardiac arrest risk.
Sandbox_EHR_HeatExhaustionEnabled_toolti: Hot weather builds heat exhaustion exposure. At High exposure, heat stroke checks occur every 5 game minutes; 100%% exposure guarantees heat stroke.
Sandbox_EHR_HeatStrokeEnabled_tooltip: Lethal heat illness caused by untreated heat exposure. Disables heat stroke contraction while keeping heat exhaustion available.
Sandbox_EHR_ConcussionEnabled_tooltip: Head trauma from serious falls and vehicle crashes. Causes headache, nausea, dizziness, and temporary impairment.
Sandbox_EHR_DeliriumEnabled_tooltip: Mental breakdown from prolonged maximum stress. Causes hallucinations, intrusive actions, and disturbing audio events until treated.
Sandbox_EHR_InsomniaEnabled_tooltip: Sleep disorder from prolonged exhaustion or stimulant crashes. Severe insomnia prevents sleep until treated.
Sandbox_EHR_PainkillerAddictionEnabled_t: Dependency from taking painkillers too often. Withdrawal brings cravings, stress and unhappiness until treated with Buprenorphine.
Sandbox_EHR_AHTREnabled_tooltip: Acute hemolytic transfusion reaction from incompatible blood transfusions. Dangerous and potentially lethal.
Sandbox_EHR_CorpseSicknessEnabled_toolti: Acute sickness from corpse putrefaction gases. This controls ordinary corpse exposure illness; cadaveric aspergillosis has its own toggle.
Sandbox_EHR_CadavericAspergillosisEnable: Fungal lung infection from decaying corpses in damp, rainy, wet or cold conditions. Progressive respiratory failure.
Sandbox_EHR_PutrefactionSicknessEnabled_: H2S gas poisoning from corpses in enclosed spaces. Causes olfactory fatigue (stop smelling = DANGER). Can knock you unconscious!
Sandbox_EHR_CorpseDiseaseSpeed_tooltip: How fast corpse sickness progresses. 1.0 = normal.
Sandbox_EHR_BodyTemperatureEnabled_toolt: Body temperature effects from EHR. <LINE> <LINE> ON: <LINE> - Hypothermia as a disease, driven by body temperature <LINE> - Shivering and sweating warnings before illness (see Pre-Disease Effects) <LINE> - The Warming Pack, and hot or cold food and drink, warm or cool the body <LINE> <LINE> OFF: all of the above stop. Disease fevers still raise body temperature. The vanilla temperature system is never replaced.
Sandbox_EHR_TemperatureChangeSpeed_toolt: How quickly fevers rise and break, and how quickly a Warming Pack warms you. <LINE> <LINE> EXAMPLES: <LINE> - 0.25 = Very slow (4x longer) <LINE> - 1.0 = Normal (default) <LINE> - 2.0 = Fast (2x quicker) <LINE> - 4.0 = Very fast
Sandbox_EHR_PreDiseaseEffectsEnabled_too: Warnings before cold or heat makes you ill. <LINE> <LINE> EFFECTS: <LINE> - Shivering and remarks when cold; slower movement when very cold <LINE> - Sweating and remarks when hot; faster thirst when very hot <LINE> <LINE> A fever alone does not count as being hot. Needs the Body Temperature System.
Sandbox_EHR_PainSoundsEnabled_tooltip: Character vocalizes pain when injured. Pain sounds attract zombies!
Sandbox_EHR_CoughSoundsEnabled_tooltip: Play audible EHR cough voice sounds. Disabling this does not remove cough dialogue or the noise that attracts zombies.
Sandbox_EHR_PainSoundCooldown_tooltip: Minimum seconds between pain vocalizations. 300 = 5 minutes.
Sandbox_EHR_ZombieAttractionRadius_toolt: How far zombies can hear pain sounds. Higher = more dangerous.
Sandbox_EHR_DialogueFrequency_tooltip: How often your character speaks about injuries, diseases, and other health events.
Sandbox_EHR_FirstAidXPEnabled_tooltip: Award First Aid skill XP for medical actions like taking medication, treating diseases, blood transfusions, and self-examination.
Sandbox_EHR_FirstAidXPMultiplier_tooltip: Multiplier for First Aid XP gained from EHR medical actions. <LINE> <LINE> EXAMPLES: <LINE> - 0.0 = No XP (disabled) <LINE> - 0.5 = Half XP <LINE> - 1.0 = Normal XP (default) <LINE> - 2.0 = Double XP <LINE> - 5.0 = 5x XP (fast learning) <LINE> <LINE> BASE XP VALUES: <LINE> - Take medication: 5 XP <LINE> - Correct treatment: 3 XP <LINE> - Cure disease: 20 XP <LINE> - Blood transfusion: 10 XP <LINE> - Self-examination: 1-5 XP
Sandbox_EHR_TheLastPrescriptionEnabled_t: Adds The Last Prescription on 47.0 MHz. Morning broadcasts grant small First Aid XP; evening broadcasts can unlock disease knowledge if heard.
Sandbox_EHR_MedicalWatchRequired_tooltip: When enabled, the EHR blood volume bar requires a Medical Monitor Watch. Disable to always show blood data.
Sandbox_EHR_KnoxCureItemsEnabled_tooltip: Allow Knox Virus Cure items to spawn in the world. <LINE> <LINE> ITEMS AFFECTED: <LINE> - Phalanx Pills (slows infection) <LINE> - Antibody Test Kit (detects infection stage) <LINE> - Immunobooster Shot (boosts resistance) <LINE> - Gene Therapy Kit (cures Knox Virus) <LINE> <LINE> These ultra-rare items only spawn in the Military Research Facility basement near Rosewood. <LINE> <LINE> Disable this if you want a more vanilla zombie experience with NO cure possibility.
Sandbox_EHR_MedicationLootMultiplier_too: Scales EHR medication and medical supply spawn chances. <LINE> <LINE> 0.0 = disabled, 0.5 = half, 1.0 = default, 2.0 = double.
Sandbox_EHR_MedicalWatchLootMultiplier_t: Scales Medical Monitor Watch spawn chance copied from vanilla red digital watches. <LINE> <LINE> 0.0 = disabled, 0.35 = rare, 1.0 = vanilla watch rate.
Sandbox_EHR_MedicationPackageFill_toolti: Controls how many doses remain inside spawned multi-dose medication packages.
Sandbox_EHR_AllowFullPharmacyPackages_to: Allows pharmacies and drugstores to occasionally spawn full medication packages. Other locations are still capped below full.
Sandbox_EHR_HouseholdPrescriptionLoot_to: Allows rare prescription medication leftovers to spawn in houses, bedrooms, desks, and similar non-medical locations.
Sandbox_EHR_PatientZeroTraitDisabled_too: When enabled, Patient Zero is hidden during character creation and Gene Therapy only cures the current Knox infection without granting permanent Knox immunity.
Sandbox_EHR_DebugMode_tooltip: Enable EHR Debug Menu access (press G). Also enables console logging. Does NOT require Steam -debug flag. In multiplayer, admin privileges are also required.
Sandbox_EHR_StitchMinigameEnabled_toolti: When enabled, stitching deep wounds opens a short EHR suturing minigame before the vanilla stitch action. Disable for vanilla stitching.
Sandbox_EHR_TetanusChanceMultiplier_tool: Scales tetanus contraction rolls from deep wounds with glass. <LINE> 1.0 = current balance. <LINE> 0.5 = half chance. <LINE> 0 = disabled chance without hiding the disease.
Sandbox_EHR_FoodPoisoningChanceMultiplie: Scales food poisoning rolls from rotten, burned, stale, dangerous uncooked, and unsafe uncooked food. <LINE> 1.0 = current balance.
Sandbox_EHR_GastroenteritisChanceMultipl: Scales gastroenteritis rolls from dirty or bloody hands. <LINE> 1.0 = current balance.
Sandbox_EHR_TrichinosisChanceMultiplier_: Scales trichinosis rolls from raw or undercooked wild game meat. <LINE> 1.0 = current balance.
Sandbox_EHR_ScabiesChanceMultiplier_tool: Scales the scabies roll while sitting on natural ground. <LINE> 1.0 = current 3%% check every 15 in-game minutes.
Sandbox_EHR_ScabiesWinterBlock_tooltip: When enabled, scabies ground exposure cannot trigger in December, January, or February.
Sandbox_EHR_ScabiesSnowBlock_tooltip: When enabled, scabies ground exposure cannot trigger on snow-covered tiles or during active snow cover.
Sandbox_EHR_DysenteryChanceMultiplier_to: Scales dysentery rolls from tainted water, toilets, rivers, lakes, and rain collectors. <LINE> 1.0 = current balance.
Sandbox_EHR_CommonColdExposureMultiplier: Scales how quickly cold/wet exposure accumulates before common cold rolls. <LINE> 1.0 = current balance.
Sandbox_EHR_CommonColdChanceMultiplier_t: Scales the final common cold contraction roll after exposure is ready. <LINE> 1.0 = current balance.
Sandbox_EHR_ConcussionFallChanceMultipli: Scales concussion rolls from serious height falls after trauma validation. <LINE> 1.0 = current balance.
Sandbox_EHR_ConcussionVehicleChanceMulti: Scales concussion rolls from severe vehicle crashes after trauma validation. <LINE> 1.0 = current balance.
Sandbox_EHR_HeatExposureTemperatureThres: World or vehicle-inside temperature where heat exposure starts accumulating. <LINE> Default: 30C.
Sandbox_EHR_HeatExposureStartHour_toolti: Hour when outdoor heat exposure begins accumulating. <LINE> Default: 9 (09:00). Equal start and end hours enable all-day accumulation.
Sandbox_EHR_HeatExposureEndHour_tooltip: Hour when outdoor heat exposure stops accumulating and begins cooling. <LINE> Default: 20 (20:00).
Sandbox_EHR_HeatExposureHoursToFull_tool: How many in-game hours of baseline heat exposure are needed to fill the heat exposure bar. <LINE> Default: 4 hours.
Sandbox_EHR_HeatExposureGainMultiplier_t: Scales how quickly heat exposure builds up once the temperature threshold is met. <LINE> 1.0 = current balance.
Sandbox_EHR_HeatExposureRecoveryMultipli: Scales how quickly heat exposure drains indoors or below the heat threshold. <LINE> 1.0 = current balance.
Sandbox_EHR_HeatStrokeChanceMultiplier_t: Scales heat stroke contraction/progression rolls from heat exposure. <LINE> 1.0 = current balance.
Sandbox_EHR_HeatHeadwearExposureMultipli: Multiplier applied to heat exposure buildup while wearing headwear. <LINE> Lower means stronger protection. <LINE> Default: 0.30.
Sandbox_EHR_HypothermiaStage1Temp_toolti: Core temperature threshold for hypothermia stage 1. <LINE> Default: 35C.
Sandbox_EHR_HypothermiaStage2Temp_toolti: Core temperature threshold for hypothermia stage 2. <LINE> Default: 34C.
Sandbox_EHR_HypothermiaStage3Temp_toolti: Core temperature threshold for hypothermia stage 3. <LINE> Default: 32C.
Sandbox_EHR_HypothermiaStage4Temp_toolti: Core temperature threshold for hypothermia stage 4. <LINE> Default: 31C.
Sandbox_EHR_HypothermiaClearTemp_tooltip: Core temperature required to clear temperature-driven hypothermia. <LINE> Default: 35.5C.
Sandbox_EHR_ImmunitySystemEnabled_toolti: Calculates and displays the character's immune system score, dirtiness, and bloodiness.
Sandbox_EHR_ImmunityGameplayEffects_tool: Allows immunity to modify supported infection risks and contain an incubating wound infection. It never changes active disease symptoms, progression, exposure, or treatment.
Sandbox_EHR_ImmunityEffectStrength_toolt: Scales immunity's effect on supported infection risks and wound containment. 0.0 = monitoring only, 1.0 = default, 2.0 = double effect within safety caps.
Sandbox_EHR_ImmunityRecoveryRate_tooltip: Scales how quickly the immune system score rises toward its current target. 1.0 = default.
Sandbox_EHR_ImmunityDeclineRate_tooltip: Scales how quickly the immune system score falls toward its current target. 1.0 = default.
Sandbox_EHR_BloodTypeTraitsDisabled_tool: When enabled, the blood type traits are hidden during character creation and every character rolls a random blood type. Characters who already picked one keep it.
